discovery_notes: Follow-up 7 of B014 (packets 214, 421, 463, 495, 518, 537, 557; Disney Store 2018). 27 standard WebSearches, excluded domains blocked, search snippets/summaries only. No new pin records: no lead yielded per-pin evidence from a non-reseller source. New set-level facts: Christopher Robin DSSH release set keyed with 3 Aug 2018 date (DPB + DPF thread title); Memories set 5 theme (1950s Atomic Age, EU listing). Animation Celebration lead closed as Epcot. No hold released. Resellers (jd-collectibles, collectionhero, yourwdwstore, millerbrostoys) not used.
